definitions.gloss: disembarkation; getting off a ship; going ashore
definitions.explanation: The act of leaving a ship or boat, either at a port of call or at the final destination. Used in both formal travel contexts and everyday situations involving ferries and boats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下船|げせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いたら→着く：00680_tsuku⟧{下船|げせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When we arrive at the port, please prepare to disembark.

examples.japanese: クルーズ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下船|げせん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The disembarkation procedures for the cruise ship took a while, but we managed to get ashore safely.

notes:
Compound of {下|げ} (down, off) and ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (ship). The opposite of ⟦{乗船|じょうせん}→乗船：16793_jousen⟧ (boarding a ship).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下船|げせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disembark
- {下船|げせん}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: disembarkation procedures
- {下船|げせん}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: permission to disembark
- {下船|げせん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: disembarkation time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗船|じょうせん}→乗船：16793_jousen⟧: boarding a ship — the opposite action
- ⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧: landing, going ashore — emphasizes stepping onto land
- ⟦{下車|げしゃ}→下車：00068_gesha⟧: getting off a vehicle (train, bus, car)
- ⟦{降機|こうき}→降機：29366_kouki⟧: deplaning, disembarking from an aircraft
